notes.title: Bundles of sales, with Twin Sails and Acram Digital
notes.content:
We at Twin Sails Interactive are thrilled to bring you an exclusive Steam bundle in partnership with Acram Digital! Get Splendor and Stone Age: Digital Edition together and save your precious gems with massive discounts for a limited time!

[h2]Don't miss out on getting these two Must-Have Strategy Games:[/h2]
[list][*] [b]Splendor[/b]: Become a Renaissance merchant, collect gems, and build your trade empire in this elegant, fast-paced strategy game.
[*] [b]Stone Age[/b]: Digital Edition: Lead your prehistoric tribe to prosperity by gathering resources, developing tools, and advancing civilization.[/list]

notes.title: The 10 best board games on PC
notes.content:
Did you hear? Board games are cool again. In fact, they re so cool that big hitters from the cardboard world are making their way over to the digital one on a more and more regular basis. To help you get your virtual collection of cardboard started, we ve gathered the 10 best board games available on PC today, all in one handy list. You ll find co-op hits, thinky strategy and everything in-between. The thing they all have in common is that they re worth your time and precious pennies, so there s no need to roll the dice, so to speak.

(more…)

notes.title: Grab Carcassone and Splendor for cheaps in Fanatical s digital board games sale
notes.content:
Sometimes, when a board game loves a personal computer very much, they create something new. Fanatical have got seven digified board games on sale, and there are some gooduns tucked between those I’m not familiar with. Small World 2 and Splendor are my highlights, though there’s also the likes of Pandemic, Carcassonne, Mysterium and Ticket To Ride.

Digital board games tend to be a poor substitute for playing against real world fleshsacks. But sometimes there are no fleshsacks within reach.

(more…)

notes.title: Have You Played Splendor?
notes.content:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time.

Aha, a loophole! Some of the board games in the embarrassingly large tower behind me have been digitised, so I’m free to write about them without muddying the PC-focused waters of Have You Played. Let’s see … ooh, Splendor is rather pleasant.

(more…)

notes.title: The beta testing program for Splendor Online Multiplayer will start today!
notes.content:
Dear Splendor players,

We are happy to announce that the beta testing for Splendor Online Multiplayer will start today!

To take part to the beta, please follow these steps:
[list]
[*] Right click on the Splendor application in your Library
[*] Select "Properties"
[*] Go to the "BETAS" tab
[*] Select the version named "beta_testing"
[*] Launch the game after it is updated Note that you do not need a code (this is an open beta).
[/list]

We are looking forward to read your comments on this new feature so please share your feedback using the following form:
http://www.daysofwonder.com/en/contact/splendor-beta

And please note that if bugs are welcome, feelings and kudos are appreciated as well :)
